Updated the capital-movements skill and memory.

Generalized lesson saved: for early-1939 weekly Treasury Bulletin capital-movement questions, when the prompt asks for “net total capital inflow/outflow” between the U.S. and a region like Latin America, use the printed weekly total net capital-movement entry for the exact date interval, including securities/brokerage components unless the prompt explicitly says to exclude them. Avoid answering from only the liquid-banking-funds/banking subsection.
